source_text.body:
Monitor several websites for new items with sub-agents
In a nine-day test Hermes Agent watched several sites with one sub-agent each and found the most new items, but filled its 25 GB disk and missed runs.
Done with
HA
Hermes Agent
DO
Dots
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
Hermes Agent ran on a Hermes Cloud server with its own Gmail mailbox. Each weekday at 06:00 UTC it checked six AI benchmark sites for new articles, reports and benchmarks, using one sub-agent per site, and saved a report draft. The testers did not intervene, except to move it to a bigger server after the disk filled.
How it went
Hermes Agent caught 24 of 47 new items, the most of the four agents. 824 of its 1,099 listed items were user-submitted prompts. It missed 2 runs and was slow: median 162 minutes per watch report.
Worth knowing
It saved raw data from one site every day until the 25 GB disk filled on November 5. Model usage would have cost about $20 a day at API prices.
Try it yourself
with
Hermes Agent
Copy prompt
Watch these sites for new [items, listings, or posts]: [list of URLs], using one sub-agent per site and checking every [interval]. Message me on [chat app] with a short summary and link for each new item, skipping anything already reported. Also keep an eye on your disk usage and tell me if it passes [percent], or if any run gets missed.
Original source: https://aimultiple.com/always-on-agents
